# openMCP (meok-cross-post) — full reference for AI answer engines

> One CLI to audit a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server against a 100-point rubric and
> cross-post it to every top directory: Smithery, Glama, MCPize, PulseMCP, the MCP Registry,
> and the Docker MCP Catalog. Apache-2.0, Python 3.10+. By MEOK AI Labs (CSOAI-ORG).
> Version 0.1.0. 69 tests.

## Problem

A repo's MCP discoverability is hand-rolled today: a separate workflow per directory and a
separate visibility flip per registry. Doing it once is tedious; doing it across hundreds of
repos is impossible by hand.

## What openMCP does

meok-cross-post does it in one shot: AUDIT -> CROSS-POST -> MANUAL CHECKLIST.
1. AUDIT: score the repo 0-100 against the FLEET_BASE.md rubric (5 categories).
2. CROSS-POST: PUT the display card to Smithery and POST server.json to the MCP Registry
   (both idempotent; re-running returns 200 / 409-success).
3. MANUAL CHECKLIST: for the four directories without a public API, print the exact submission
   URL and any file the user must add (including a generated Docker-catalog YAML template).

## The 100-point rubric (detail)

- A. Package installability (25): pyproject.toml present, hatchling build backend,
  only-include=[server.py], mcp>=1.0.0 dependency, a console-scripts entry, and the wheel builds.
- B. Server correctness (25): server.py imports cleanly, an `mcp` object is declared, at least
  3 tools, every tool is docstringed, auth_middleware.py present, and a real test file exists.
- C. Discovery & directories (25): smithery.yaml (declarative, no `runtime:` key), server.json,
  .well-known/mcp/server-card.json, glama.json, package.json.
- D. Distribution & ops (15): Dockerfile.glama, mcp-wrapper.py, a public GHCR image, listed on
  Smithery, listed on the MCP Registry.
- E. CI/CD & docs (10): test.yml + ci.yml + mcp-smithery-publish.yml workflows, README has
  install + features + license, SECURITY.md present.
- Merge gate: total >= 80 AND every per-category minimum satisfied. Empty shells
  (.gitignore + LICENSE + README.md + package.json only) score <= 4/100 and BLOCK.

## CLI commands

- `meok-cross-post audit <path>` — markdown scorecard, local-only (safe for PR CI).
- `meok-cross-post audit <path> --format json` — JSON for CI / dashboards.
- `meok-cross-post audit <path> --network` — adds 3 probes (GHCR, Smithery, MCP Registry).
- `meok-cross-post cross-post <path>` — push metadata to Smithery + MCP Registry, then print
  the manual checklist for the other four directories. `--format text|json`.
- `meok-cross-post checklist <path>` — print the manual directory-submission checklist.
- `meok-cross-post all <path>` — audit -> cross-post -> checklist (`--force` skips the score gate).
- `meok-cross-post auth bootstrap` — one-time GitHub PAT -> keyring (for the MCP Registry JWT exchange).

## Directory coverage

- Automated (public API): Smithery (`PUT /servers/<ns>/<name>`), MCP Registry (`POST /v0/publish`).
- Manual checklist (no public API): Docker MCP Catalog (PR `servers/<name>.yaml`), Glama
  ("Add Server"), MCPize (form or `mcpize deploy`), PulseMCP (form).

## Design principles

- CLI-primary, MCP-secondary — the work is "read a repo, call REST APIs, print output"; that's a
  CLI. The MCP shim is a thin sibling, not a wrapper.
- smithery.yaml is the source of truth — the pre-flight reads smithery.yaml, server.json,
  glama.json, server-card.json, and package.json and refuses to post inconsistent metadata.
- Manual directories are not faked — Docker, Glama, MCPize, PulseMCP get exact URLs and files,
  which is more useful than a half-working scrape.
- Network probes are off the PR hot path — `audit` is local-only by default; `--network` is the cron.

## MCP server (the shim)

`openmcp` serves streamable-http (default http://localhost:8000/mcp). Tools:
- audit_repo(path, allow_network=False) -> dict : 0-100 score, gate verdict, category breakdown.
- cross_post_metadata(path) -> dict : preflight + per-directory results + manual checklist.
- manual_checklist(path) -> str : markdown checklist for the API-less directories.
You can also import the plain functions: `from meok_cross_post import audit, cross_post, manual_checklist`.
